meta.title: reel: films and series from torrents, playing in seconds
meta.description: reel is a source-available app with a built-in torrent engine. Pick a film or an episode and it starts playing while it streams. Releases come only from a search source you add yourself. Made for the TV first.
how.title: How it works
hero.title: Pick a film. It plays in seconds.
hero.lead: Films and series from torrents. Nothing to download first.
shots.label: Drawings of reel's home screen on each device it runs on
shots.caption: reel on a TV, a Mac, Windows and Linux, an iPad, an iPhone and Android. Drawn for this page; the titles are public-domain films.
tizen.lead: reel isn't in Samsung's app store. You set up TV-Store once from a computer, then install and update reel with the remote.
tizen.step1_text: On the TV, open Apps and press 1 2 3 4 5 on the remote. Switch Developer mode on and type your computer's IP address.
tizen.store2_text: With Apps2Samsung on the computer, install TV-Store on the TV and press Arm TV-Store in the TV's Toolbox. Then change the IP in Developer mode to 127.0.0.1.
tizen.store3_text: Open TV-Store on the TV, find reel and press OK.
tizen.store_small: From then on the TV needs no computer: reel's updates show up in TV-Store. TV-Store needs a TV from 2017 or later.
tizen.alt_text: Also for TVs from before 2017. After step 1, download the package and install it on the TV with Apps2Samsung; each update goes the same way.
how.lead: Three steps, and the first one you do once.
how.mock_ok: Connected. It searches by IMDb id.
how.step1_text: Paste a Torznab address and key in Settings, or scan the QR code on the TV.
how.step2_text: Browse or search. reel finds releases your device can play.
how.step3_text: It starts in seconds and keeps minutes ready ahead.
privacy.title: Open code, no accounts
privacy.lead: The whole app is on GitHub: a Rust core with the torrent engine, and one interface for every platform. Its code is open to read, change and share for any noncommercial purpose under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0; commercial use is not allowed.
privacy.no_account: No reel account and no sign-in.
privacy.local: Settings and watch progress stay on your device.
privacy.talks_source: Your search source, at the address you entered.
privacy.talks_meta: TMDB, AniList and Jikan, for titles, posters and descriptions.
privacy.talks_ids: A public anime ID list on GitHub, to match anime between catalogs.
privacy.talks_peers: Other people sharing the film. As with any torrent app, they can see your IP address.
ios.lead: reel isn't in the App Store. You install it with SideStore, a free app that installs apps with your own Apple ID.
ios.side1_text: Follow its guide. You need a computer once, for about 10 minutes.
ios.side2_text: Open this page on the iPhone and tap the button.
ios.side3_text: In SideStore, open reel and tap Install.
ios.side_small: SideStore renews reel every 7 days by itself and brings its updates. iOS 15 or later.
ios.alt_text: Keep AltServer running on a computer on the same Wi-Fi, or reel stops opening after 7 days.
